about_everest_p1: Everest Education was founded in 2019 as a leading company in the field of educational consulting, specializing in helping international students achieve their academic dreams at the best Turkish universities.
about_everest_p2: Since its launch, Everest has successfully built bridges of communication between thousands of students from around the world and the finest educational institutions in Turkey, providing comprehensive services covering all stages of the student's educational journey.
about_everest_p3: Thanks to our team of professional consultants and our strong partnerships with more than 50 Turkish universities, we continue to provide the best customized educational solutions for each student, contributing to building a brighter future for the next generations.
mission_desc: Professional educational consultants striving to provide the best services for international students and help them build their academic future.
vision_desc: To be the first and trusted choice for international students wishing to study in Turkey, by providing distinguished and comprehensive services.
